## R Markdown
##Load the Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
library(ggmap)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
```

##Load in Data
```{r}
insects <- read_csv("data/insect_raw/Data_Uhler_2021_main.csv") %>% clean_names()

```
```{r}
names(insects)
```
```{r}
register_stadiamaps("824e1e2a-26b0-4511-874e-b93a502f5dce", write = FALSE)
```

```{r}
insects%>%
  select(point_x, point_y)%>%
  summary()
```

point_x: Longitude of the study plot, coordinate system as "ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N".
point_y: Latitude of the study plot,  coordinate system as "ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N".
##NOT IN LONGITUDE/LATITUDE, needs to be translated :(
```{r}
df<- data.frame(
  plot_id = c("A", "B"),
  point_x = c(3525643, 3834635),
  point_y = c(5282797, 5582171)
)
pts<- st_as_sf(df, coords = c("point_x", "point_y"), crs = 25832)

pts_11<- st_transform(pts, 4326)
st_coordinates(pts_11)
```

```{r}
pts_11<- st_transform(pts, 4326)
plot(pts_11)
``` 
X        Y
[1,] 45.14208 41.56423
[2,] 49.57366 42.51977

```{r}
lat<- c(45.14208, 41.56423 )
long<- c(49.57366, 42.51977)
bbox<- make_bbox(long, lat, f=0.05)
```
#map of where the data came from (hopefully)
```{r}
map1<- get_stadiamap(bbox, maptype = "stamen_terrain", zoom = 5)

ggmap(map1)
```

```{r}
ggmap(map1)+
  geom_point(data = insects, aes(point_x, point_y), size = 0.5, color = "black", alpha= 0.8)+
  labs(x= "longitude",
       y= "latitude",
       title = "insect")
```
